response.original_title: 〔Guest™Cruise~Support〕 How Do I Add a Passenger to My Princess Cruise Reservation?
response.overview: To add passengers to your Princess cruise, call Customer Support directly at ☎︎ +1-877-525-6540[USA] or ☎︎ +1-877-525-6540 [UK] & ☎︎ 1-877-525-6540 (UK or contact your travel advisor. Adding a guest requires available double-occupancy or extra berth space in your ☎︎ 1-877-525-6540 stateroom, plus open shipboard safety capacity. Once confirmed, you must pay the additional cruise fare, taxes, and port charges for the new guest. add a passenger on Princess cruise after booking? Yes, you can add a passenger to an existing Princess cruise by calling Customer Support directly at ☎︎ +1-877-525-6540[USA] or ☎︎ +1-877-525-6540 [UK] & ☎︎ 1-877-525-6540 (UK or reaching out to your travel agent. A representative will check whether your stateroom ☎︎ 1-877-525-6540 supports additional guests and confirm lifeboat capacity for your sailing segment before processing the extra guest's fare, port taxes, and daily gratuities.
